subject: Pilot scope, budget and latency options — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex@pockethealth.co>, Marta Lopez <marta@pockethealth.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot scope, budget and latency options — next steps

Hi Alex / Marta — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can formalize a pilot scope: 

What we heard (please correct if I missed anything):
- Product: chat-centric assistant for clinician workflows (triage / note drafting) + background batch summarization of visit logs.
- Traffic profile: currently estimating 200–400 concurrent active users during peak hours, ~120k–300k API calls/day in month-1 growth projection (see attached volume CSV). Average prompt+response ~700 tokens; average per-call tokens ~1.2k.
- Latency SLOs: interactive chat target ~200–300ms p50 (comfortable up to p95 ~500ms), background summarization can accept 1–2s.
- Budget: initial pilot budget range you quoted: $60k–$80k/month (including infra & support). Target unit economics you mentioned: ~ $400–$650 per 1M tokens (for planning).

Two configuration trade-offs we discussed:
1) Streaming/low-latency path (hosted or dedicated multi-tenant streaming) — best UX for chat, higher unit cost due to single-token streaming and smaller effective batching. Estimated range (hosted streaming, p50 <200ms): $1,600–$2,200 per 1M tokens. Dedicated reserved capacity can lower that to ~$700–$1,100/1M depending on commit.
2) Batch/quantized path (for background jobs and non-interactive flows) — much lower per-token cost due to higher batch sizes and more aggressive quantization: estimated $400–$900 per 1M tokens.

What I need from you to finalize a pilot estimate:
- Confirm the expected monthly token volume range you want us to size for (low/nominal/high). I used 100M / 300M / 900M tokens per month for the attached worksheet.
- Confirm the target max spend for the pilot (is $80k/month the hard cap?).
- Confirm whether chat UX must have p95 <500ms (we'll size for streaming) or p95 can be relaxed / staged (we can design mix of streaming + batch fallbacks).

Proposed next steps:
- You: reply with the three clarifications above (volume bands, pilot budget cap, latency hard SLO).
- Me/Karthik: produce a 2-page pilot SOW + pricing estimate (hosted vs dedicated scenarios) and a rollout plan (canary + fallbacks).
- Schedule 30-min follow-up for Thurs 6/24 or Fri 6/25 to review the SOW and signoff.

Attachments: pilot_scope_matrix.xlsx (blank template we filled), pockethealth_volume_profile.csv (your volume assumptions), draft pricing note placeholder (we'll attach full PDF once we size).

Thanks — I’ll hold a slot for Thurs 2:00–2:30 PM PT.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Alex Green <alex@pockethealth.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot scope, budget and latency options — next steps

Soojin — quick technical notes / clarifying questions so we size correctly:

1) Traffic shape: are the ~120k–300k calls/day evenly distributed or spiky during clinic hours? If spiky, please share a sample hour-by-hour profile — spikes drive concurrency and affect reserved pool sizing.
2) Token distribution: how many calls are expected to be short prompts (~<256 tokens) vs long (>2k tokens)? This changes batching efficiency and KV-cache behavior.
3) Desired rollout: do you want canary traffic split by region or by user cohort? Canary by cohort is lower risk and lets us tune batching for heavy users first.

Notes on pricing buckets (ballpark, subject to verification):
- Hosted streaming (single-tenant optimizations limited): ~$1,600–$2,200 per 1M tokens (interactive heavy).
- Hosted batching (good for summarization): ~$450–$850 per 1M tokens.
- Dedicated reserved (1yr commit, regional pool): unit cost can drop ~30–60% vs hosted depending on utilization and model quantization.

If you can confirm the three items above, I’ll run a quick cost model (CSV) and include a mixed routing recommendation (streaming for foreground, batching for background) for the SOW.

Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Green <alex@pockethealth.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@pockethealth.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot scope, budget and latency options — next steps

Thanks — appreciate the recap. Answers inline: 

- Volumes: nominal month target for pilot: ~250M tokens/month (we expect burst to 400M in marketing weeks). Low/nominal/high bands: 120M / 250M / 400M.
- Budget cap: $75k/month for the pilot (covers usage + SRE support + SLA).
- Latency SLO: for the interactive assistant we need p50 <250ms and p95 <500ms for clinician UX; background jobs can be >1s. If we can’t hit p95 <500ms with pure streaming within budget, we’re open to a hybrid: streaming for top-10% of requests (real-time triage) and batching for everything else.

We attached a filled pilot estimates sheet (pilot_scope_matrix.xlsx) with our traffic mix and a sample hour-of-day distribution.

Two quick asks: can Redwood provide a preliminary estimate showing 3 scenarios (hosted streaming, hosted hybrid, dedicated reserved) with expected monthly cost and expected p95 for the interactive path? Second, we need to know the minimal commit size to make dedicated cost-effective (ballpark commit level).

We’re available Thurs 6/24 at 2pm PT for the follow-up.

—
Alex Green
Head of Product, PocketHealth
alex@pockethealth.co | +1 617-555-0229

Subject: Re: Pilot scope, budget and latency options — next steps

Perfect — thanks for the quick clarifications, Alex. Action items from our side before Thurs 2pm PT: 

1) Karthik / infra: we’ll produce a three-scenario cost table (hosted streaming, hosted hybrid, dedicated reserved) with expected monthly $ and estimated p50/p95 for the interactive path. We’ll flag assumptions for batching window, quantization level, and expected utilization.
2) Marissa: we’ll attach a short note on billing cadence and any up-front reservation mechanics.
3) Me: will send an SOW draft and a one-page rollout plan (canary by cohort).

I’ll include a preliminary unit-cost summary in the SOW. Ballpark numbers we’ll test in the model (again, subject to verification after pilot telemetry):
- Hosted streaming (p95 <500ms): ~$1,800–$2,000 per 1M tokens
- Hosted hybrid (streaming for top traffic + batching for rest): ~$850–$1,200 per 1M tokens (effective blended rate)
- Dedicated reserved (sustained 1yr commit, high utilization): ~$350–$650 per 1M tokens

We’ll upload the pricing estimate PDF and the cost CSV to the shared drive and drop the link in HubSpot. Meeting invite for Thurs 6/24 2:00–2:30 PM PT sent — please accept.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf (prelim), pilot_scope_matrix_filled.xlsx (your updated sheet)

Thanks — talk Thurs.

—
